user.title: Connect to UniFi Protect
user.description: Use the console's address on your network and an API key created in UniFi OS under Control Plane → Integrations (a Protect-only key is enough).

data_description.verify_ssl: Leave off for the console's default self-signed certificate.

cameras.title: Doorbells
cameras.description: Pick the doorbells with a screen.

abort.already_configured: This console is already set up.

data_description.preview_folder: Folder with a picture per uploaded image, named like the upload (for example cat_halloween_small.gif). Leave empty to use the unifi_doorbell_display folder in your config folder (created on setup).
data_description.default_image: Picture for the default message. Leave empty to use a file named default (any image type) in the preview folder, otherwise a card with the name is drawn.

set_image.name: Set image
set_image.description: Show an uploaded image on the doorbell screen.

image.name: Image
image.description: Name or id of an uploaded image (see the Available images sensor).

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Show it for this long, then fall back. Leave empty to keep it.

then.name: Then
then.description: Image to show after the duration instead of the default animation.

set_text.name: Set text
set_text.description: Show a text on the doorbell screen.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Show it for this long, then fall back. Leave empty to keep it.

then.name: Then
then.description: Image to show after the duration instead of the default animation.

reset_display.name: Reset display
reset_display.description: Go back to the default message of UniFi Protect.
